title: ATLAS solver_project manifest
description: Declares how a complete solver pipeline runs under atlas-batch / batch_runner.py. Fields may be added in 0.x; renames/removals require a major version.

name.description: Solver / system name stamped on evaluation rows

command.description: Argv to execute; cwd is workdir

workdir.description: Working directory relative to the manifest file

artifact.description: Fallback path (relative to workdir) if ATLAS_SUBMISSION_PATH is not honored

budget_hours.description: Wall-clock budget on the runner host (not Kaggle hardware parity)
